extraction.name: LongVid
extraction.description: A large-scale long video instruction-tuning dataset comprising 114,228 long videos and 3,444,849 question-answering (QA) pairs across five different task types, supporting models to handle diverse long video scenarios. The dataset includes videos from Ego4D, HowTo100M, HD-Vila, and MiraData, encompassing movies, egocentric videos, news, interviews, how-to videos, and other in-the-wild videos of long duration.
extraction.creator: Shanghai AI Laboratory, Nanjing University, Shenzhen Institutes of Advanced Technology, Chinese Academy of Sciences, Shanghai Innovation Institute
extraction.rai:dataCollection: The dataset leverages the rich diversity of existing datasets, including Ego4D, HowTo100M, HD-Vila, and MiraData, encompassing a wide range of video types: movies, egocentric videos, news, interviews, and how-to videos, and other in-the-wild videos of long duration. For data curation, dense event labels are generated for each long video. Existing high-quality short video captions are utilized (Panda-70M for HD-VILA, CosMo for HowTo100M, Ego4D-HCap for Ego4D, and the original high-quality captions provided in MiraData) and consecutive segments that can be regrouped into a long video sequence are filtered, then a sequence of event labels with their corresponding timestamps for every long video based on their captions is constructed.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: Videos are curated from 4 open-source video datasets: Ego4D, HowTo100M, HD-VILA, and MiraData. Captions are sourced from Panda-70M for HD-VILA, CosMo for HowTo100M, Ego4D-HCap for Ego4D, and original captions from MiraData. Event-level annotations are sourced from HT-Step for HowTo100M and Ego4D-HCap for Ego4D.
extraction.rai:dataManipulationProtocol: For datasets with high-quality event-level annotations (HT-Step for HowTo100M, Ego4D-HCap for Ego4D), these are directly utilized as the event labels. For others, the major event is extracted from the caption using an LLM. Consecutive segments that can be regrouped into a long video sequence are filtered. Event labels with corresponding timestamps are constructed for every long video based on their captions.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Dense event labels are generated for each long video. Consecutive segments that can be regrouped into a long video sequence are filtered. A sequence of event labels with their corresponding timestamps for every long video based on their captions is constructed. Several types of long video QA pairs are constructed based on the video captions, event labels, and the timestamps of short video segments. They are categorized into five tasks: video captioning, temporal grounding, event relation recognition, scene relation recognition, and video event counting.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: For datasets with high-quality event-level annotations (HT-Step for HowTo100M, Ego4D-HCap for Ego4D), these annotations are directly utilized as the event labels. For other datasets, the major event is extracted from the caption using an LLM (Qwen-72b). Several types of long video QA pairs are constructed based on the video captions, event labels, and the timestamps of short video segments, categorized into five tasks: video captioning, temporal grounding, event relation recognition, scene relation recognition, and video event counting.
extraction.rai:annotationsPerItem: Multiple QA pairs per video, with 3,444,849 QA pairs across 114,228 videos
extraction.rai:machineAnnotationTools: LLM (Qwen-72b) used to extract event labels from captions for MiraData and HD-VILA videos
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Training, Fine Tuning. The dataset is used for joint short and long video instruction tuning to enable the model to handle videos of different lengths and different types of tasks. It supports five task types: video captioning, temporal grounding, event relation recognition, scene relation recognition, and video event counting.
